title: Uplands
wikitext:
[[Image:The Ulands.jpg|thumb|The Uplands]]
'''The Uplands''' are a region in the northern [[Alterac Mountains]]. The area was the bread basket of the Kingdom of [[Alterac]], but after the destruction of the core of that nation, the Uplands fell under the control of the [[Syndicate]]. They remain under their control to this day.

This is a good place for Herbalists. There are nodes of [[Fadeleaf]], [[Goldthorn]], [[Khadgar's Whisker]] and [[Wintersbite]], which is only found in the center region of the [[Alterac Mountains]].
